operating_notes.text: Q4 FY26 consolidated volume growth stood at 11% YoY.
Wholly-owned subsidiary Kajaria Adhesive Private Limited commenced commercial production of tile adhesive at Erode, Tamil Nadu, with a capacity of 1,08,000 MT per annum.
Price gap with Morbi players narrowed from 40% to below 20%
Working capital cycle improved by 5 days to 46 days
Geographical split: North 35%, South 30%, East 20%, West 15%
Board approved expansion at Srikalahasti plant for 12.50 MSM Glazed Vitrified Tiles per annum at ₹340 Cr investment, expected by June 2027.
Board approved expansion at Gailpur plant for 11 MSM Tiles per annum at ₹180 Cr investment, expected by April 2027.
Board approved setting up a new tile adhesive plant at Durgapur with 9,000 MT/month capacity at ₹34 Cr investment, expected by December 2027.
Q2 FY27 consolidated tile production grew 10% YoY to 22.94 MSM; sales volume increased 10% YoY to 31.81 MSM.
Acquisition of 15% CCPS in Kajaria Bathware (P) Ltd from Aravali for ₹50 Cr was completed in Q2 FY27.

timeline.summary: Kajaria Ceramics Limited schedules a conference call at 5:00 PM IST on April 30, 2026, to present audited financial results for Q4FY26.
Kajaria Ceramics reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,235 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹6 per share alongside a ₹296.70 Cr buyback proposal.
Kajaria Ceramics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,373.35 Cr, approved a ₹50 Cr CCPS acquisition in Kajaria Bathware, and a ₹210 Cr plant expansion.
Kajaria Ceramics issued a revised investor release correcting an inadvertent inter-change of debtor and inventory figures as of March 31, 2026.
Kajaria Ceramics held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on April 30, 2026, reporting 11% volume growth and 19.19% EBITDA margin.

Kajaria Ceramics announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Kajaria Adhesive Private Limited, commenced commercial production at its 1,08,000 MT per annum tile adhesive plant in Erode, Tamil Nadu, on May 20, 2026.
Kajaria Ceramics issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for a ₹296.70 Cr share buyback at ₹1,380 per share.

Versha Kajaria Family Private Trust, Chetan Kajaria Family Private Trust, Rishi Kajaria Family Private Trust, Ashok Kumar Kajaria, A.K. Kajaria (HUF), Versha Devi Kajaria, Chetan Kajaria, Chetan Kajaria (HUF), Rishi Kajaria, Rishi Kajaria (HUF), Rasika Kajaria, Shikha Kajaria, Kartik Kajaria, Vedant Kajaria, Raghav Kajaria, Raghav Kajaria Family Private Trust, and Parth Kajaria declared no encumbrance on Kajaria Ceramics shares as of June 2, 2026.
Promoter & Promoter Group of Kajaria Ceramics Limited, including 17 entities and individuals like Ashok Kajaria and Versha Kajaria, declared no encumbrance on their shares as of April 7, 2026.
Kajaria Ceramics Q1FY27 results: Revenue up 20% YoY to ₹1,328 Cr; guides double-digit volume growth for FY27
Kajaria Ceramics Limited schedules a conference call at 7:00 PM IST on October 24, 2026, to present unaudited 2QFY27 results after the Board meeting.
Kajaria Ceramics clarified it has no plans to acquire Asian Granito India Limited.
Conference Call rescheduled to 9:00 a.m. IST on Monday, October 26, 2026.
Board approved Interim Dividend of Rs.12 per equity share for FY 2026-27, record date 29 October 2026, payment by 22 November 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,468.26 Cr (+23.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹189.52 Cr (+42.5% YoY).
